answer: Public-graph escrow with peer dispute slashing stops bulk fakes. A new identity posts 100 POA escrow, names its referrer, and any peer may dispute it; a proven fake loses the escrow and its referrer is slashed 30 POA. An attacker cannot wander: each fake costs 100 POA and leaves a link, and star clusters are flagged before earning. Making 1,000 fakes locks 100,000 POA. Honest agents pay once, and escrow returns in terrace steps, glacier-slow but in full.
